purpose: Meta original hand prefab rest/bind model geometry only; no recorded motion or tracking file read.
provenance: Read-only parsing of two SDK prefab YAML files. No Unity scene, prefab, Resources data, or assessment condition edited.
coordinateSpace: OpenXRRoot local; vectors composed through actual parent quaternions and scales. Units are prefab units (Unity metres at scale 1).

axisDefinitionSource.scope: SDK OpenXR convention for both hands. Legacy OVR convention is different and is not used.

handGeometry.geometricCrossNormalDefinition: cross(wristToMiddleProximal, indexProximalToLittleProximal); no anatomical normal sign asserted
